_comment: Manual corrections applied on top of Liquipedia's scraped data, for real-world changes Liquipedia hasn't been updated to reflect yet. Each entry is scoped to one team + one player handle (case-insensitive). Re-applied every time the data is rebuilt, so these survive re-scrapes rather than needing to be re-patched by hand each time. Add more entries the same shape as this one when you spot another gap.
